M1_memo_lifecycle.label: SOURCE+PROVEN (pure-Python path): memo dict is owned by the JSONDecoder instance and captured by py_make_scanner closure; it is NOT recreated per parse.

M2_intra_doc_key_identity.label: PROVEN (C impl): PyDict_SetDefault canonicalises equal keys within one scan; hook still SAW both duplicate forms.
M2_intra_doc_key_identity.py_impl_note: py scanner interns via memo.setdefault; identity across escape/literal depends on intern table, not memo.

M2_cross_parse_identity.label: PROVEN: no cross-parse identity leak in the C path under test (memo cleared at end of each scan_call). Disproves the earlier 'persistent memo' hypothesis with a VALID key-object test.

M3_reentrant_same_decoder_pyscanner.label: see trace; inner decode clears/resets the SHARED decoder memo mid-outer-parse (py path keeps using it afterwards).

M3_reentrant_same_decoder_Cscanner.label: PROVEN: reentrant decode() on the same C-scanner decoder completes without crash/error; verdict unaffected for these inputs. Memo-state consequence unobservable from Python (C memo hidden) -> INFERRED clearing from disasm (PyDict_Clear@0x2ef6 after scan_once call).

M3b_recursion_guard_via_reentry.label: PROVEN: recursion check lives in the HOST (frame budget), not in the validator; reentrancy consumes the same budget as data nesting.

M4_error_identity.label: PROVEN (measured, not asserted): exception retains the SAME str object; retention is documented interface behaviour (SOURCE: self.doc = doc), so classify as lifetime fact, not spill.

M5_representation_boundary.memoryview: TypeError: the JSON object must be str, bytes or bytearray, not memoryview
M5_representation_boundary.label: PROVEN: the validation region accepts ONLY str; every other byte representation is rejected by decode()/raw_decode BEFORE scanning. Whoever converts bytes->str (decode/normalize) sits OUTSIDE this subsystem -- the subsystem's assumption is that input is already str.

M6_callback_inventory.label: PROVEN: five caller-supplied callbacks (parse_int, parse_float, parse_constant, object_hook, object_pairs_hook) all execute DURING scanning, before document-level acceptance. Old map listed only the two object hooks -> incomplete inventory.
